mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TOKEN, REG_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO) AS REG_NO, RATIO_NO, MEMBER_ID, OWNER_NM, TN.TASK_CD, TN.PROC_CD, NTAX_TRGET_CD, NTAX_WHO, NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD, -- 신규등록인 경우 차량번호 REQ_CAR_NO CASE WHEN TS.WORK_CD = '010' THEN TN.REQ_CAR_NO ELSE TS.CAR_NO END AS CAR_NO, (SELECT pkg_common.fn_decrypt(MPHONE_NO) FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE LOGIN_ID = TS.MEMBER_ID ) AS MANAGER_TEL FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND TOKEN = #{TOKEN}

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TOKEN, DEBTOR_NM, TOI.DEBTOR_GB AS DEBTOR_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.REG_NO) AS DEBTOR_REG_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_OWNERINFO TOI, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD WHERE TOI.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND TOKEN = #{TOKEN} AND TOI.SEQ = '0'
